content:
Overview

Layton is a city in UT with a population of 80,000. Davis County city with Hill Air Force Base and the Layton Hills Mall. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 32.5.
